title: Coarse information and finite rank obstructions for flat lattice Hodge forms
abstract: On finite periodic unit-spacing lattices, necessary coarse-information budgets constrain flat Hodge forms and constructed derivative repairs. We consolidate physical Fourier-band, tangent, exact regular-sector, signed-weight and full-volume rank results with separately pinned formal evidence and analytic arguments. A critical inverse-conductance moment suffices for a global spectral observation of the mean-budget order. Actual rectangular means have a general D/4 upper rate and the target D/2 rate for an explicitly restricted scaled-cube class. Constructive counterexamples obstruct a retained-grid single-threshold algorithm and a universal exact supplied-cube decomposition, while the same profiles admit successful rectangular partitions. The unrestricted critical rectangular question remains open. No interacting or continuum Yang-Mills mass gap is established.
